applied_coverage: Programs with at least one admitted selected expression transformation; old and newly supplied families remain distinguishable in complete receipts.
useful_coverage: Programs (and separately fraction of fixed nonempty cells) with at least one >=5% gain, paired timing interval excluding one and changed generated artifact against their same-lane current-catalogue baseline. This is evaluation-only, never selection evidence.
limits: A useful result in one regime does not erase regressions in another. Coverage is over the fixed ten-operation cohort, not a population of software. Identical-artifact timing variation is retained but does not count as knowledge coverage.
